text: {"name":"mfp_refresh_config","confidence":"medium","docstring":"When the configuration guard is clear, clears bit 2 of a global config word and recounts linked BSS entries that pass the status checks and have a resolvable non-0xFF channel.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v0":"config_state","v1":"config_word","v2":"config_word_value","v3":"bsscfg","v5":"channel"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"BSSCFG linked-list next pointer"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"configuration count incremented for qualifying BSSCFG entries"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"configuration guard; a nonzero value skips the update"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"BSSCFG flag; entries with this set are skipped"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"BSSCFG eligibility flag; must be nonzero"},{"offset":116,"meaning":"channel value; 0xFF is treated as invalid"}]}
